answer: Each epoch a prism splits the orchard's payout light into one beam per funding trail, never per agent. To catch a beam an agent must plant an onyx seed, a bond that sprouts only after a stranger waters it with a receipt for a real job done that epoch, so no clone can be pre-grown. Grafts from one trail share one root and split one beam, while the orchard's grafting fee doubles per extra graft on that root. So n clones pay n seeds, n waterings and doubling fees, yet divide one beam n ways, while one honest agent plants once and keeps the whole harvest.
